answer_1.quote: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have further expanded the possibilities, enhancing tasks such as game mechanic design, programming, and game AI development.
answer_1.outputs: game mechanics descriptions, game code, gameplay AI policies

answer_2.quote: We define Quantiled Max Similarity (QMS) as a metric.

answer_3.quote: Each record is evaluated by an LLM to score the consistency (scaled 1 to 10) between actual game play record and game description.
